cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Let's prepare the chair for our visitor from tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The calculation says they can't arrive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. A chair won't hurt while the calculation finishes being pessimistic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So we can see the next useful task.
